d:
Long, straight obsidian-black hair reaching the waist. Narrow, cold crimson-red eyes with a haughty expression. Apparent age is mid-twenties with a stern, aristocratic face. Slender, elegant build. Wears a high-collared black robe with gold embroidery and a long, sweeping cape in royal purple. A singular gold earring hangs from the left ear.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
